title: Nutella Nachos
description: A sweet and spicy twist on classic nachos. This dessert combines the richness of Nutella with the spicy kick of bhuna.

ingredients.name: Bhuna Sauce
ingredients.notes: You can use more or less depending on desired spice level

instructions: 2. Arrange the tortilla chips in a single layer on a baking sheet.
3. Drizzle the Nutella over the tortilla chips.
4. Sprinkle the bhuna sauce over the Nutella.
5. Bake in the preheated oven for 5-7 minutes, or until the Nutella has melted and the tortilla chips are crispy.
6. Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes.
